title: Sunday · the Grunion Run, 2018
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: The run with phones in it: half the lanterns are screens now, blue among the orange, and the fish come in anyway. The pup at the surf. The man on the sand with neither.
